title: Error ratio per service
intro: Checkout is flaky. Compute the fraction of requests that fail with 5xx, per service, as a ratio between 0 and 1.
hints: Divide the 5xx rate by the total rate. Both sides need the same labels.
debrief: Aggregate both sides by the same labels before dividing, or the series won't match. payments is failing about 20% of requests.
